changes.text: DextraVerse: a second real-robot task, unscrew_bottle_cap, was added to the Hugging Face repo (commit cc7a4456, 2026-10-31): 56 episodes, 16,417 frames at about 14.6 Hz (19 min), a 5.7 GB zarr archive, with a left hand holding the bottle and a right hand unscrewing the cap, and new deform3 and distforce fingertip maps from SharpaWave SDK 5.x. Real-robot totals are now 317 episodes and 154,799 frames in 2 tasks (were 261 and 138,382 in 1); availability stays public, license CC BY 4.0.
